cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: Athenian democracy developed in stages: Solon's reforms (594 BC) cancelled debts and banned debt slavery; Cleisthenes (508 BC) reorganised citizens into demes and tribes; Pericles (460s BC) introduced pay for office holders

cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: The ecclesia (assembly) was the sovereign decision-making body: all male citizens could speak and vote on laws, war, treaties and ostracism

cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: The boule (council of 500) set the agenda for the assembly and oversaw day-to-day administration; members were chosen by lot from the ten tribes

cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: Ostracism allowed citizens to exile one person for 10 years by majority vote, removing potential tyrants

cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: The court system (dikasteria) used large citizen juries (201-501 members) chosen by lot, ensuring popular justice

cards.front: Recall a key point about Athens & the Birth of Democracy
cards.back: Democracy was direct (not representative): citizens voted on issues themselves, not through elected representatives
